title: Plain-input SAT whenever a small strong 2-CNF backdoor exists
claims: SmallStrongBackdoorSATInP constructs a language in the exact reference P contained in the exact reference SAT. It is complete on encoded CNFs admitting any strong deletion backdoor a to 2-CNF with 8^a.card bounded by a fixed polynomial in input length.
The input supplies only the original SAT encoding. The proof checks a scanner for three still-unassigned literal positions, bounded branching on the scanner output, and a residual 2-SAT verifier.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
